summary: Strategy Inc, the former MicroStrategy, filed an 8-K disclosing routine weekly updates under Items 7.01 and 8.01, including no ATM sales or bitcoin trades from September 8-13, 2026. It repurchased 1,420,467 shares of its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC) for $139.3 million, leaving $1.05 billion available under its preferred repurchase program and $1.0 billion under its MSTR common stock program. Strategy holds approximately 845,050 bitcoin at an average price of $75,412 each. The buyback reduces preferred equity overhang, supported by its USD Reserve. Watch for continued repurchases and their impact on preferred liquidity and dividend coverage.
